allowances.qualification: binary64 full512 numerical pilot; no rounding enclosure

original_input.local_cli_path: Provide --input pointing to the same fixed bytes; cache outside old evidence is permitted

execution_order: passive SOURCE/input/previous-scope/versions/resource check; fresh B3 run01 only
read original saved packet and saved B0/B1/B2 evidence bundle; verify identities, metrics scope and old PASS provenance
use B1 exact spin recipe; nine G reconstruction/unitarity certificates inside one model prepare; compare frame/eigenvalue recipe metadata

build raw actual adjoint; P0 compile one B3 kernel; build compiled actual adjoint with no translator mutation overlap
parallel decode compiled and two actual adjoints according to available resource_plan; segment,dagger/reference/recovery checks
raw/compiled X/Y through saved head/tail and own-XDF ground; all complex checks before native metrics
one new metrics record; three fixed B3 comparisons against saved B1 XDF/B2 XDF/B2 CDF; quote saved B0 metrics only
save QPY4,new full512 operator packets4,all gates,journal,resources,STOP; publish and verify; mandatory STOP

call_definitions.saved_input_load: one existing load_input evaluation whitelist read; no Hamiltonian generation or DF/PF error computation
call_definitions.saved_evidence_load: one registered JSON evidence bundle load, ten saved records; no arrays or old circuits built
call_definitions.saved_identity: saved SOURCE/contract/STOP,DF reserve,full512 scope,P0/precision and native metrics validation only; no old PASS transfer to B3
call_definitions.native_model: one invocation of existing B1 exact-spin preparation; includes nine spatial eigensolves and G/unitarity reconstruction checks,not new DF decomposition
call_definitions.model_gate: nine spin-recipe records/frame IDs/signed lambdas/eigenvalue ordering versus saved B1; no claim of bitwise saved-U identity
call_definitions.gaussian_build: nine absolute basis requests including cache hits
call_definitions.relative_gaussian: cache misses only, at most16 directed consecutive run boundaries; identical-basis sharing may reduce actual count
call_definitions.ground_load: one saved-state decode with normalization<=1e-12, no eigensolve
call_definitions.operator_decode: one raw and one compiled full512; actual adjoint2 counted separately
call_definitions.segment_assessment: existing raw/ref,compiled/raw/ref,unitarity,Frobenius pilot; no full SVD or13round propagation
call_definitions.adjoint_gate: each actual inverse checked against dagger,independent reference and recovery
call_definitions.signal_reference: one own-ground expectation of saved independent system target
call_definitions.signal_axis: four expectations: raw/compiled times X/Y,using unchanged saved shell operators
call_definitions.metrics: only after all B3 correctness gates PASS
call_definitions.cost_comparison: three per-kernel comparisons exactly COMPARATORS order; main scientific comparator is B2_CDF_relative

reuse.B0: saved original native results and profile; no build,compile or reaggregation
reuse.B1: same exact spin recipe and saved G certificates/local PASS as provenance; no B1 circuit rerun
reuse.B2: same relative Gaussian and vacuum phase code; reuse all scalar metrics/conditions; no old kernel rerun
reuse.reference: saved XDF full256 target built from original independent CAR; never rebuilt from B3 coefficients
reuse.shells: six unchanged raw/compiled head/X/Y full512 matrices; no shell circuit regeneration
reuse.DF_PF_ground: saved XDF8 approximation/PF/alias and own-DF oracle identity unchanged; no new norm,eigenpair or PF analysis
reuse.B3_correctness: new full512 raw/compiled/actual adjoint/XY gates required; cannot inherit B1/B2 PASS

resources.parallelism: resource_plan for three independent post-P0 matrix decodes,BLAS coordinated; raw gate is sequential dependency; one kernel means one build and one P0; no global changes
resources.cache: task-local .cache/h4-b3 and fresh output; no shared cache/environment modifications

stop_rules: first SOURCE/input/spin/phase/order/reference/compile correctness FAIL stops dependent calls; finish safely already-started decode jobs, preserve partial evidence
nonfinite or incompatible inputs explicitly FAIL; no projection,approximate replacement or legacy fallback
no old run restart,rank/route/precision/profile alteration,no post-hoc threshold relaxation; retry/resume0
normal and FAIL both preserve SOURCE/results/journal/STOP then commit/push/remote verification and mandatory STOP
interpretation: Report signed RZ/CX/depth/size differences and classical timing for one s1 kernel only. No universal metric winner,new same-CA total ranking,novelty or formal C1 continuation/closure decision.
authorization: Separate explicit user permission in chat required for science; no approval record,certificate,text storage or new grant.
